Assurance only: source inspection is read-only; no product repairs or self-approval.
Focused guidance is the default. Full audit requires the selected external capability,
resolved scope/budget, independent review, isolated output, validator readiness and
execution policy. Never equate this installation with READY or a running scanner.
Target-controlled execution needs an OS sandbox with external network disabled,
sanitized environment and resource/write limits. A worktree is not a sandbox.
If only source review is available, retain dynamic coverage gaps as needs_validation.
